overview: Bellman-Ford routing tables, updates, count-to-infinity, convergence.
coreConcept: D(x,y) = min over neighbours v of c(x,v) + D(v,y).
hinglishExplanation: Har router neighbours ke vectors se apna table update karta hai. Link cost badle to naye vectors exchange hote hain; bad news slow (count to infinity).
formalDefinition: D(x,y) = min over neighbours v of c(x,v) + D(v,y).
